summary: Round 1 had no findings. Since then only test code has changed. The acceptance test now sorts records by sessionId so they are no longer in chronological order, and it adds Custom/Tough line-up filters. The cashPool helper in tests/support/stat-records.ts takes an optional LineUpPreset through configForLineUp. Neither is shipped code or reads untrusted input, and the production path (g2Target, trendData, StatisticsScreen) is unchanged. There are no new dependencies, secrets, network calls or randomness, so there are no findings.
